statement: The three faculty anchors (untreated course, one red-cell unit, slow crystalloid) were tested together against the current GI physiology, read-only. Under the declared reading of the one-unit window (minute 30) the intersection is NONEMPTY with a kernel inside the closed crystalloid region, so by FD-RATE-13 Amendment 3 is not opened. Nothing executable changed; no rate, pressure parameter or kernel is approved; no point is chosen; no FR-G V2 candidate exists.
